features.name: nsw_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing supply-demand pressure in a scale-normalized way.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a meaningful axis for neighborhood grouping based on market pressure conditions.

features.name: vic_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, analogous market pressure feature for Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides parallel market-pressure dimension for KNN distance balancing.

features.name: interstate_price_gap
features.description: Absolute difference between NSW and VIC normalized prices, indicating cross-region price divergence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Sharpens neighborhood geometry by separating rows with similar within-region but different cross-region prices.

features.name: interstate_demand_gap
features.description: Signed difference of NSW minus VIC demand reflecting load imbalance between states.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures directional demand imbalance relevant to transfer dynamics.

features.name: transfer_centered
features.description: Transfer flow centered on its midpoint to highlight net flow direction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes transfer flow symmetric for distance calculations.

features.name: period_cyclic_distance
features.description: Cyclic distance of period from midday (0.5), reflecting how far the time-of-day is from peak demand window.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a symmetric time-of-day descriptor improving neighborhood matching for similar load periods.

features.name: peak_period_indicator
features.description: Indicator for periods within typical peak demand windows (mid-morning and evening).
features.expected_model_benefit: Cluster indicator improving KNN separation between peak and off-peak rows.

features.name: high_demand_indicator
features.description: Joint indicator flagging high demand across both NSW and VIC simultaneously.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a co-stress regime that creates discrete cluster geometry for KNN.

features.name: price_log_scale
features.description: Log-scaled NSW price to compress extreme price spikes for distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dominance of price outliers in Euclidean distance.

features.name: distance_to_typical_row
features.description: Euclidean distance from row to the unsupervised global mean prototype across key normalized features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an unsupervised outlier-distance signal that aids KNN weighting and tie-breaking.

features.name: price_demand_coherence
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether NSW and VIC price-demand patterns move coherently versus divergently, computed as a normalized similarity score combining sign-agreement of deviations from each variable's mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a market-regime coherence signal that improves clustering of structurally similar market states.

features.name: market_stress_level
features.description: Semantic ordinal indicator (low=0.0, moderate=0.5, high=1.0) of overall electricity market stress combining elevated prices, high demand, and unusual transfer flows, derived from row values relative to training-set typical ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a coarse regime cluster indicator that helps KNN group rows by market condition severity.
